items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Red hired me, and I sat in a section with Babe Russin and a guy named Fletcher somebody.

ctx.x: Tell us a bit about Red. What was Red like?
At the Park Central. Oh, Red was . . . He was a Bix follower, but he wouldn’t admit it. He was limited.
Quite a good arranger, though, wasn’t he?
